-- ****************************************************************************
--  Nokia Subscriber and Equipment Trace Application Protocol eXtended
--  Version: 1.12.3
--  Encoding: ASN1 aligned PER
--  Author: BTS Trace Controller Team
--
--  Confidential
--  Copyright (c) 2024 Nokia. All rights reserved.
-- ****************************************************************************

TraceProtocol DEFINITIONS AUTOMATIC TAGS ::=
BEGIN
TraceMessage ::= CHOICE {
    configure               Configure,
    alive                   IsAlive,
    startSession            StartSession,
    stopSession             StopSession,
    startRecordingSession   StartRecordingSession,
    stopRecordingSession    StopRecordingSession,
    report                  Report,
    ...
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  Configure msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
Configure ::= SEQUENCE {
    nodeType        NodeTypeId,
    version         Version,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {}
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  IsAlive msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
IsAlive ::= SEQUENCE {
    nodeType                    NodeTypeId,
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StartSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StartSession ::= SEQUENCE {
    seqNum          SequenceNumber,
    sourceId        SynchronizationSourceId,
    nodeType        NodeTypeId,
    traceReference  TraceReference,
    cellId          CellTypeId OPTIONAL,
    timestamp       UTC-Timestamp,
    sessionConfig   SessionConfig,
    extension       StartSessionExtension OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StopSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StopSession ::= SEQUENCE {
    seqNum          SequenceNumber,
    sourceId        SynchronizationSourceId,
    nodeType        NodeTypeId,
    traceReference  TraceReference,
    cellId          CellTypeId OPTIONAL,
    timestamp       UTC-Timestamp,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StartRecordingSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StartRecordingSession ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceActivationType         TraceActivationType,
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    sourceId                    SynchronizationSourceId,
    nodeType                    NodeTypeId,
    traceReference              TraceReference,
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef,
    cellId                      CellTypeId OPTIONAL,
    recordInitSeqNum            SequenceNumber,
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    extension                   StartRecordingSessionExtension OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StopRecordingSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StopRecordingSession ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceActivationType         TraceActivationType,
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    sourceId                    SynchronizationSourceId,
    nodeType                    NodeTypeId,
    traceReference              TraceReference,
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef,
    cellId                      CellTypeId OPTIONAL,
    recordEndSeqNum             SequenceNumber,
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    extension                   StopRecordingSessionExtensionUeId OPTIONAL
}

StopRecordingSessionExtensionUeId ::= SEQUENCE {
    ranUeId             RAN-UE-Id OPTIONAL,
    futureExtension     SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  Report msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
Report ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceActivationType         TraceActivationType,
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    sourceId                    SynchronizationSourceId,
    nodeType                    NodeTypeId,
    traceReference              TraceReference,
    cellId                      CellTypeId OPTIONAL,
    recordingSessionReportList  RecordingSessionReportList OPTIONAL,
    futureExtension             SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  Types
-- ****************************************************************************

TraceActivationType ::= ENUMERATED {mba, sba}

ASN1-MsgId ::= INTEGER (0..65535)

ASN1-PayloadContainer ::= OCTET STRING

Direction ::= ENUMERATED {ul, dl, none}

Global-eNB-Id ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    enb-Id          ENB-Id
}

ENB-Id ::= CHOICE {
    macro-eNB-Id        BIT STRING (SIZE (20)),
    home-eNB-Id         BIT STRING (SIZE (28)),
    shortMacro-eNB-Id   BIT STRING (SIZE (18)),
    longMacro-eNB-Id    BIT STRING (SIZE (21)),
    ...
}

GNB-CU-UE-F1AP-Id ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
GNB-DU-UE-F1AP-Id ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
GNB-CU-CP-UE-E1AP-Id ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
GNB-CU-UP-UE-E1AP-Id ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
RAN-UE-Id ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (8))

UeCallType ::= ENUMERATED {
    sa,
    endc,
    nrdc,
    spare1,
    ...
}

Global-gNB-Id ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    gnb-Id          GNB-Id
}

GNB-Id ::= CHOICE {
    gnb-id  BIT STRING (SIZE (22..32)),
    ...
}

GNB-CU-UP-Ids ::= SEQUENCE {
    gnb-cu-up-Id    GNB-CU-UP-Id,
    gnb-Id          Global-gNB-Id OPTIONAL
}

GNB-CU-UP-Id ::= INTEGER (0..68719476735)

GNB-DU-Ids ::= SEQUENCE {
    gnb-du-Id   GNB-DU-Id,
    gnb-Id      Global-gNB-Id OPTIONAL
}

GNB-DU-Id ::= INTEGER (0..68719476735)

NodeTypeId ::= CHOICE {
    gnb-cu-Id       Global-gNB-Id,
    gnb-cu-up-Ids   GNB-CU-UP-Ids,
    gnb-du-Ids      GNB-DU-Ids,
    ...,
    enb-Id          Global-eNB-Id
}

StartSessionExtension ::= SEQUENCE {
    node-Info           Node-Info,
    futureExtension     SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

Node-Info ::= SEQUENCE {
    timezone-min    INTEGER,
    ...
}

StartRecordingSessionExtension ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceRecordingSessionConfig     TraceRecordingSessionConfig OPTIONAL,
    node-Info                       Node-Info OPTIONAL,
    extension                       StartRecordingSessionExtensionUeId-r2 OPTIONAL
}

StartRecordingSessionExtensionUeId-r2 ::= SEQUENCE {
    ranUeId             RAN-UE-Id OPTIONAL,
    extension           StartRecordingSessionExtension-r3 OPTIONAL
}

StartRecordingSessionExtension-r3 ::= SEQUENCE {
    ueCallType          UeCallType OPTIONAL,
    futureExtension     SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

TraceRecordingSessionConfig ::= SEQUENCE {
    asn1-MsgRecordList          BIT STRING OPTIONAL,
    vendorExtensionRecordList   BIT STRING OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

CellTypeId ::= CHOICE {
    nrcgi   NRCGI,
    ecgi    ECGI,
    ...
}

NRCellIdentity ::= BIT STRING (SIZE(36))

NRCGI ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    cellIdentity    NRCellIdentity
}

ECGI ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    cellIdentity    CellIdentity
}

CellIdentity ::= BIT STRING (SIZE (28))

PLMN-Identity ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (3))

RecordingSessionReportList ::= CHOICE {
    cuRecordingSessionReportList      CuRecordingSessionReportList,
    cuUpRecordingSessionReportList    CuUpRecordingSessionReportList,
    duRecordingSessionReportList      DuRecordingSessionReportList,
    ...,
    enbRecordingSessionReportList     ENBRecordingSessionReportList
}

CuRecordingSessionReportList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxRecordingSessionData)) OF CuRecordingSessionReport

CuRecordingSessionReport ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef DEFAULT defaultTraceRecordingSessionRef,
    recordList                  CuRecordList,
    ...,
    ranUeId                     RAN-UE-Id OPTIONAL
}

CuRecordList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxRecords)) OF CuRecord

CuRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    direction                   Direction DEFAULT none,
    data CHOICE {
        asn1-Data               Cu-ASN1-Data,
        vendorExtensionData     CuVendorExtensionRecordData
    },
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    -- Note: timestamps can be not monotonic
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    crnti                       RNTI OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

ENBRecordingSessionReportList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxRecordingSessionData)) OF ENBRecordingSessionReport

ENBRecordingSessionReport ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef DEFAULT defaultTraceRecordingSessionRef,
    recordList                  ENBRecordList,
    enb-ue-s1ap-Id              ENB-UE-S1AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    mme-ue-s1ap-Id              MME-UE-S1AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    gummei                      GUMMEI OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

ENBRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    direction                   Direction DEFAULT none,
    data CHOICE {
        asn1-Data               ENB-ASN1-Data,
        vendorExtensionData     ENBVendorExtensionRecordData
    },
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    -- Note: timestamps can be not monotonic
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    crnti                       RNTI OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

ENBRecordList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxRecords)) OF ENBRecord

ENB-ASN1-MsgId ::= ASN1-MsgId

ENB-ASN1-Data ::= SEQUENCE {
    asn1-MsgId      ENB-ASN1-MsgId,
    asn1-Payload    ASN1-PayloadContainer,
    ...
}

ENB-VER-Id ::= INTEGER(0..63,...)

ENB-VER-PayloadContainer ::= OCTET STRING

ENBVendorExtensionRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    ver-Id          ENB-VER-Id,
    ver-Payload     ENB-VER-PayloadContainer,
    ...
}

ENBVendorExtensionRecordDataType ::= CHOICE {
    timingAdvanceRecord         ENB-TimingAdvanceTraceRecord,
    ...
}

Cu-ASN1-MsgId ::= ASN1-MsgId

Cu-ASN1-Data ::= SEQUENCE {
    asn1-MsgId      Cu-ASN1-MsgId,
    asn1-Payload    ASN1-PayloadContainer,
    ...
}

Cu-VER-Id ::= INTEGER(0..63,...)

-- carries CuVendorExtensionRecordDataType
Cu-VER-PayloadContainer ::= OCTET STRING

CuVendorExtensionRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    ver-Id          Cu-VER-Id,
    ver-Payload     Cu-VER-PayloadContainer,
    ...
}

CuVendorExtensionRecordDataType ::= CHOICE {
    ueReleaseRecord                 CuUeReleaseTraceRecord,
    sgnbAdditionRecord              SgNBAdditionTraceRecord,
    sgnbReleaseRecord               SgNBReleaseTraceRecord,
    ueMeasRecord                    UeMeasTraceRecord,
    ueInfoRecord                    UeInfoTraceRecord,
    sgnbInitiatedSgNBModRecord      SgNBInitiatedSgNBModificationTraceRecord,
    sgnbChangeRecord                SgNBChangeTraceRecord,
    menbInitiatedSgNBModRecord      MeNBInitiatedSgNBModificationTraceRecord,
    hoSrcRecord                     CuHoSrcTraceRecord,
    hoTgtRecord                     CuHoTgtTraceRecord,
    ...,
    bearerRecord                    CuBearerTraceRecord,
    caConfigurationRecord           CuCaConfigurationTraceRecord,
    ueDuConnectivityRecord          UeDuConnectivityTraceRecord,
    ueSetupRecord                   CuUeSetupTraceRecord,
    pduSessionResourceInfoRecord    PduSessionResourceInfoTraceRecord,
    menbConnectivityRecord          MeNBConnectivityTraceRecord,
    intragNBHoSrcRecord             IntragNBHoSrcTraceRecord,
    intragNBHoTgtRecord             IntragNBHoTgtTraceRecord,
    rrcSetupRecord                  CuRrcSetupTraceRecord,
    xnHoSrcRecord                   CuXnHoSrcTraceRecord,
    xnHoTgtRecord                   CuXnHoTgtTraceRecord,
    ngHoSrcRecord                   CuNgHoSrcTraceRecord,
    ngHoTgtRecord                   CuNgHoTgtTraceRecord,
    ueCuUpConnectivityRecord        UeCuUpConnectivityTraceRecord
}

CuUeReleaseTraceRecord ::= CHOICE {
    data    CuUeReleaseTraceRecordData,
    ...
}

CuUeReleaseTraceRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    classifier              CuCallFinalClassifier,
    ...
}

CuCallFinalClassifier ::= SEQUENCE {
    finalClass          CuCallFinalClass,
    primaryQualifier    CuCallFinalClassPrimaryQualifier,
    secondaryQualifier  CuCallFinalClassSecondaryQualifier
}

CuCallFinalClass ::= ENUMERATED {
    normal,
    abnormal,
    spare6,
    spare5,
    spare4,
    spare3,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}

CuCallFinalClassPrimaryQualifier ::= ENUMERATED {
    none,
    menbInitiated,
    sgnbInitiated,
    pSCellChange,
    spare4,
    spare3,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}

CuCallFinalClassSecondaryQualifier ::= ENUMERATED {
    none,
    internal,
    ueCtxSetupFailure,
    admissionControlFailure,
    menbCommunicationFailure,
    x2LinkFailure,
    f1LinkFailure,
    intraDuHo,
    interDuHo,
    intergNBHo,
    scgConfigReject,
    e1LinkFailure,
    partialReset,
    releaseDueToPreemption,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}

SgNBAdditionTraceRecord ::= CHOICE {
    data    SgNBAdditionTraceRecordData,
    ...,
    data-r1 SgNBAdditionTraceRecordData-r1
}

SgNBAdditionTraceRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    result                          SgNBAdditionResult,
    enb-Id                          Global-eNB-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id                 UE-X2AP-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id-Ext             UE-X2AP-Id-Ext OPTIONAL,
    sgnb-ue-x2ap-Id                 SgNB-UE-X2AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    sgnbAdditionReqRcvTime          UTC-Timestamp,
    sgnbAdditionReqAckSndTime       UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    sgnbAdditionReqRejectSndTime    UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    sgnbReconfCmplRcvTime           UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    snStatusTransferRcvTime         UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    duUeCtxSetupData                DuUeCtxSetupData OPTIONAL,
    caConf                          CuCaConfiguration OPTIONAL,
    bearerData                      CuBearerData OPTIONAL,
    ...,
    [[
    triggerReason                   SgNBAdditionTriggerReason
    ]]
}

SgNBAdditionTraceRecordData-r1 ::= SEQUENCE {
    triggerReason                   SgNBAdditionTriggerReason,
    result                          SgNBAdditionResult,
    enb-Id                          Global-eNB-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id                 UE-X2AP-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id-Ext             UE-X2AP-Id-Ext OPTIONAL,
    sgnb-ue-x2ap-Id                 SgNB-UE-X2AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    sgnbAdditionReqRcvTime          UTC-Timestamp,
    sgnbAdditionReqAckSndTime       UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    sgnbAdditionReqRejectSndTime    UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    sgnbReconfCmplRcvTime           UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    snStatusTransferRcvTime         UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

SgNBAdditionResult ::= ENUMERATED {
    success,
    cacFailure,
    gnbCuCapacityExceeded,
    acTimerTimeout,
    bearerTypeValidationFailure,
    qciValidationFailure,
    ipAddressVersionValidationFailure,
    duUeCtxSetupFailure,
    duUeCtxSetupTimeout,
    cuBearerSetupTimeout,
    menbCommunicationFailure,
    pdcpNack,
    gtpuErrors,
    gnbCuUpBearerCtxSetupFailure,
    gnbCuUpBearerCtxSetupTimeout,
    miscFailure,
    ...,
    cplaneOverloadCausedFailure
}

SgNBAdditionTriggerReason ::= ENUMERATED {
    initialNsaCall,
    snChange,
    interMeNBHo,
    spare5,
    spare4,
    spare3,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}

DuUeCtxSetupDataList ::= SEQUENCE OF DuUeCtxSetupData

DuUeCtxSetupData ::= SEQUENCE {
    result                  DuUeCtxSetupResult OPTIONAL,
    gnb-du-Ids              GNB-DU-Ids,
    gnb-cu-ue-f1ap-Id       GNB-CU-UE-F1AP-Id,
    gnb-du-ue-f1ap-Id       GNB-DU-UE-F1AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    ueCtxSetupReqSndTime    UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    ueCtxSetupCmplRcvTime   UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    ...,
    [[
    initialUeRrcMessageTransferRcvTime UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL
    ]]
}

DuUeCtxSetupResult ::= ENUMERATED {
    success,
    failure,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}

CuCaConfigurationTraceRecord ::= CHOICE {
    data    CuCaConfigurationTraceRecordData,
    ...
}

CuCaConfigurationTraceRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    setupSCells                 CuSCellSetupList OPTIONAL,
    failedToSetupSCells         CuSCellFailedToSetupList-r1 OPTIONAL,
    releasedSCells              CuSCellReleasedList OPTIONAL,
    ...,
    uplinkTxSwitchingOption     UplinkTxSwitchingOption OPTIONAL
}

UplinkTxSwitchingOption ::= ENUMERATED {
    switchedUl,
    dualUl,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}

CuSCellReleasedList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfSCells)) OF CuSCellReleaseItem

CuSCellReleaseItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    scellIndex  SCellIndex OPTIONAL,
    cellId  CHOICE {
        nrci     NRCellIdentity,
        nrcgi    NRCGI
    },
    ...
}

CuCaConfiguration ::= SEQUENCE {
    setupSCells             CuSCellSetupList OPTIONAL,
    failedToSetupSCells     CuSCellFailedToSetupList OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

SCellIndex ::= INTEGER (1..31)

SCellDirectionConfig ::= ENUMERATED {
    dl,
    uldl
}

CuSCellSetupList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfSCells)) OF CuSCellSetupItem
CuSCellFailedToSetupList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfSCells)) OF CuSCellFailedToSetupItem

CuSCellSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    scellIndex  SCellIndex,
    cellId  CHOICE {
        nrci     NRCellIdentity,
        nrcgi    NRCGI
    },
    ...,
    [[
    nrArfcnDl ARFCN-NR,
    sCellDirectionConfig SCellDirectionConfig
    ]]
}

CuSCellFailedToSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    scellIndex  SCellIndex,
    cellId  CHOICE {
        nrci     NRCellIdentity,
        nrcgi    NRCGI
    },
    ...
}

CuSCellFailedToSetupList-r1 ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfSCells)) OF CuSCellFailedToSetupItem-r1

CuSCellFailedToSetupItem-r1 ::= SEQUENCE {
    scellIndex  SCellIndex OPTIONAL,
    cellId  CHOICE {
        nrci     NRCellIdentity,
        nrcgi    NRCGI
    },
    ...,
    [[
    nrArfcnDl ARFCN-NR,
    sCellDirectionConfig SCellDirectionConfig
    ]]
}

CuBearerTraceRecord ::= CHOICE {
    data        CuBearerTraceRecordData,
    ...,
    data-r1     CuBearerTraceRecordData-r1
}

CuBearerTraceRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    setupBearers            CuBearerSetupList OPTIONAL,
    failedToSetupBearers    CuBearerFailedToSetupList OPTIONAL,
    releasedBearers         CuBearerReleaseList OPTIONAL,
    ...,
    [[
    trigger                 CuBearerTriggerReason OPTIONAL
    ]]
}

CuBearerData ::= SEQUENCE {
    setupBearers            CuBearerSetupList OPTIONAL,
    failedToSetupBearers    CuBearerFailedToSetupList OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

CuBearerSetupList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF CuBearerSetupItem
CuBearerFailedToSetupList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF CuBearerFailedToSetupItem

CuBearerSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabId      ERAB-Id,
    drb-Id      DRB-Id,
    eutran-Qos  EUTRAN-QoS OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

ERAB-Id ::= INTEGER (0..15, ...)
DRB-Id ::= INTEGER (1..32, ...)
QCI ::= INTEGER (0..255)

EUTRAN-QoS ::= SEQUENCE {
    qci         QCI,
    arp         ArpSettings,
    ...,
    [[
    gbrQosInformation       EutranGbrQosInformation OPTIONAL
    ]]
}

EutranGbrQosInformation ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabMaximumBitRateDl        BitRate,
    erabMaximumBitRateUl        BitRate,
    erabGuaranteedBitRateDl     BitRate,
    erabGuaranteedBitRateUl     BitRate,
    ...
}

ArpSettings ::= SEQUENCE {
    priorityLevel               PriorityLevel,
    preemptionCapability        PreemptionCapability,
    preemptionVulnerability     PreemptionVulnerability,
    ...
}

PriorityLevel ::= INTEGER (0..15)

PreemptionCapability ::= ENUMERATED {
    shallNotTriggerPreemption,
    mayTriggerPreemption
}

PreemptionVulnerability ::= ENUMERATED {
    notPreemptable,
    preemptable
}

CuBearerFailedToSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabId      ERAB-Id,
    drb-Id      DRB-Id,
    eutran-Qos  EUTRAN-QoS OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

CuBearerTraceRecordData-r1 ::= SEQUENCE {
    trigger                 CuBearerTriggerReason,
    setupBearers            CuBearerDataSetupList OPTIONAL,
    failedToSetupBearers    CuBearerDataFailedToSetupList OPTIONAL,
    releasedBearers         CuBearerDataReleaseList OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

CuBearerTriggerReason ::= ENUMERATED {
    other,
    intragNBHandover,
    spare14,
    spare13,
    spare12,
    spare11,
    spare10,
    spare9,
    spare8,
    spare7,
    spare6,
    spare5,
    spare4,
    spare3,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}

CuBearerDataSetupList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfDRBs)) OF CuBearerDataSetupItem

CuBearerDataSetupItem ::= CHOICE {
    eutranBearer    CuBearerEutranDataSetupItem,
    ngranBearer     CuBearerNrDataSetupItem,
    ...
}

CuBearerEutranDataSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabId          ERAB-Id,
    drb-Id          DRB-Id,
    eutran-Qos      EUTRAN-QoS OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

CuBearerNrDataSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    drb-Id                                  DRB-Id,
    pduSessionId                            PduSessionId,
    drbQoS                                  QosFlowLevelQosParameters OPTIONAL,
    setupQosFlowsMappedToBearer             CuSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerList,
    failedToSetupQosFlowMappedToBearer      CuFailedToSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerList OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

CuBearerDataFailedToSetupList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfDRBs)) OF CuBearerDataFailedToSetupItem

CuBearerDataFailedToSetupItem ::= CHOICE {
    eutranBearer    CuBearerEutranDataFailedToSetupItem,
    ngranBearer     CuBearerNrDataFailedToSetupItem,
    ...
}

CuBearerEutranDataFailedToSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabId          ERAB-Id,
    drb-Id          DRB-Id,
    eutran-Qos      EUTRAN-QoS OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

CuBearerNrDataFailedToSetupItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    drb-Id                                  DRB-Id,
    pduSessionId                            PduSessionId,
    drbQoS                                  QosFlowLevelQosParameters OPTIONAL,
    failedToSetupQosFlowMappedToBearer      CuFailedToSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerList,
    ...
}

CuBearerDataReleaseList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfDRBs)) OF CuBearerDataReleaseItem

CuBearerDataReleaseItem ::= CHOICE {
    eutranBearer    CuBearerEutranDataReleaseItem,
    ngranBearer     CuBearerNrDataReleaseItem,
    ...
}

CuBearerEutranDataReleaseItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabId          ERAB-Id,
    drb-Id          DRB-Id,
    ...
}

CuBearerNrDataReleaseItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    drb-Id          DRB-Id,
    pduSessionId    PduSessionId,
    ...
}

CuSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfQosFlows)) OF CuSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerItem

CuSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    qfi             QosFlowId,
    ...
}

CuFailedToSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfQosFlows)) OF CuFailedToSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerItem

CuFailedToSetupQosFlowMappedToBearerItem ::= SEQUENCE {
    qfi             QosFlowId,
    ...
}

SgNBReleaseTraceRecord ::= CHOICE {
    data    SgNBReleaseTraceRecordData,
    ...,
    data-r1 SgNBReleaseTraceRecordData-r1
}

SgNBReleaseTraceRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    sgnbReleaseReason           SgNBReleaseTriggerReason,
    enb-Id                      Global-eNB-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id             UE-X2AP-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id-Ext         UE-X2AP-Id-Ext OPTIONAL,
    sgnb-ue-x2ap-Id             SgNB-UE-X2AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    sgnbReleaseReqTime          UTC-Timestamp,
    sgnbReleaseRespTime         UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    snStatusTransferSndTime     UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    x2UeCtxReleaseRcvTime       UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    releasedBearerData          CuBearerReleaseData,
    duUeCtxReleaseData          DuUeCtxReleaseData,
    ...
}

SgNBReleaseTraceRecordData-r1 ::= SEQUENCE {
    sgnbReleaseReason           SgNBReleaseTriggerReason,
    enb-Id                      Global-eNB-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id             UE-X2AP-Id,
    menb-ue-x2ap-Id-Ext         UE-X2AP-Id-Ext OPTIONAL,
    sgnb-ue-x2ap-Id             SgNB-UE-X2AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    sgnbReleaseReqTime          UTC-Timestamp,
    sgnbReleaseRespTime         UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    snStatusTransferSndTime     UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    x2UeCtxReleaseRcvTime       UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

SgNBReleaseTriggerReason ::= ENUMERATED {
    menbInitiated,
    menbCommunicationFailure,

CuUpRecordingSessionReportList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxRecordingSessionData)) OF CuUpRecordingSessionReport

CuUpRecordingSessionReport ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef DEFAULT defaultTraceRecordingSessionRef,
    recordList                  CuUpRecordList,
    ...,
    ranUeId                     RAN-UE-Id OPTIONAL
}

CuUpRecordList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxRecords)) OF CuUpRecord

CuUpRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    direction                   Direction DEFAULT none,
    data CHOICE {
        asn1-Data               CuUp-ASN1-Data,
        vendorExtensionData     CuUpVendorExtensionRecordData
    },
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    -- Note: timestamps can be not monotonic
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    ...
}

CuUp-ASN1-MsgId ::= ASN1-MsgId

CuUp-ASN1-Data ::= SEQUENCE {
    asn1-MsgId      CuUp-ASN1-MsgId,
    asn1-Payload    ASN1-PayloadContainer,
    ...
}

CuUp-VER-Id ::= INTEGER(0..63,...)

-- carries CuUpVendorExtensionRecordDataType
CuUp-VER-PayloadContainer ::= OCTET STRING

CuUpVendorExtensionRecordData ::= SEQUENCE {
    ver-Id          CuUp-VER-Id,
    ver-Payload     CuUp-VER-PayloadContainer,
    ...
}

    nonDynamicFiveQiDescriptor  NonDynamicFiveQiDescriptor,
    dynamicFiveQiDescriptor     DynamicFiveQiDescriptor,
    ...
}

FiveQI ::= INTEGER (0..255, ...)

QosPriorityLevel ::= INTEGER (1..127, ...)

NonDynamicFiveQiDescriptor ::= SEQUENCE {
    fiveQi          FiveQI,
    priorityLevel   QosPriorityLevel OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

DynamicFiveQiDescriptor ::= SEQUENCE {
    fiveQi              FiveQI OPTIONAL,
    priorityLevel       QosPriorityLevel,
    packetErrorRate     PacketErrorRate,
    packetDelayBudget   PacketDelayBudget,
    ...
}

PacketDelayBudget ::= INTEGER (0..1023, ...)

    scalar      PacketErrorRateScalar,
    exponent    PacketErrorRateExponent,
    ...
}

PacketErrorRateScalar ::= INTEGER (0..9, ...)

PacketErrorRateExponent ::= INTEGER (0..9, ...)

    preemptionCapability        NrPreemptionCapability,

    ...

    mayTriggerPreemption
}

    notPreemptable,
    preemptable
}

    ...
